summary.name: Hotpot.ai
summary.one_liner: Hotpot.ai is a web-based AI creative suite for generating images and videos from text, making AI headshots and Halloween or fantasy portraits, editing and restoring photos, and making design templates.
use_cases: Generate images from a short text prompt
Animate a photo into a short video
Create professional or lifestyle headshots from one photo
Upscale, colorize, or restore old photos
Make social media, LinkedIn, or app store graphics from templates
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Hotpot as a suite of AI tools for images and video. The AI Image Generator creates images from a few words and includes AI Characters, AI Logos and AI Anime options. The AI Video Generator turns an image or text prompt into a video. AI Headshots and Halloween or fantasy portraits generate stylized versions of a person from a single uploaded photo. The AI Editor lets users describe edits, upscale images, colorize or restore old photos, and remove backgrounds. Classic Templates provide editable design layouts for items such as app store screenshots, LinkedIn banners and social posts, which the page says can be downloaded free.
notable: Portrait styles such as Corporate Studio, Fantasy Heroes (Cinematic or Art) and Halloween themes generated from one photo
AI Editor combines text-described edits with upscaling, colorization, restoration and background removal
Classic design templates advertised as free to customize and download
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page
Templates are described as free, but the page does not detail limits on the AI features
